picks.title: US pauses Iran attacks after Trump advised to halt bombing
picks.summary: The US has paused strikes on Iran for a third straight night after top military officials told Trump the bombing campaign had reached the limit of its effectiveness and warned of dwindling munitions stocks; oil prices fell on the pause while diplomatic talks continue to try to avert a return to all-out war over the Strait of Hormuz.
flags: Pause framed as tactical/munitions-driven rather than a genuine de-escalation

picks.title: Russia and Ukraine trade attacks, killing 10, including child in Chernihiv
picks.summary: Kyiv says Russian strikes killed six people, including a child at a supermarket in Chernihiv, while Moscow says Ukrainian strikes killed four — the latest exchange in a war showing no sign of slowing even as Ukraine pushes allies for a prototype European missile-defense system by mid-2027.
flags: Casualty attribution disputed between Kyiv and Moscow

picks.bucket: US as the world sees it
picks.title: Trump vows to investigate EU over fining of US tech companies
picks.summary: After the EU fined Google $1.02B for favoring its own services, Trump said antitrust fines against Google, Apple, Meta and Amazon should be "entirely reversed" and vowed to investigate the EU — the latest flashpoint in a running US-EU fight over who gets to regulate American tech giants.

picks.title: #CommonwealthGames | Mirabai Chanu ने जीता लगातार तीसरा गोल्ड
picks.origTitle: #CommonwealthGames | Mirabai Chanu ने जीता लगातार तीसरा गोल्ड
picks.summary: State broadcaster DD News celebrates weightlifter Mirabai Chanu winning her third consecutive Commonwealth Games gold medal in Glasgow, part of a run of Indian medal coverage (including a second boxing silver) dominating state news today.

picks.title: क्या इन पांच वजहों से धर्मेंद्र प्रधान को शिक्षा मंत्री पद से देना पड़ा इस्तीफ़ा
picks.origTitle: क्या इन पांच वजहों से धर्मेंद्र प्रधान को शिक्षा मंत्री पद से देना पड़ा इस्तीफ़ा
picks.summary: Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan resigned after more than a month of youth protests at Jantar Mantar over recurring exam paper leaks; BBC Hindi lays out five reasons behind the resignation and notes his own history protesting a paper leak as a student in 1997.
flags: Independent coverage foregrounds sustained protest pressure the state broadcaster's Games coverage omits

picks.title: 金正恩参谒中国人民志愿军烈士陵园
picks.origTitle: 金正恩参谒中国人民志愿军烈士陵园
picks.summary: North Korean leader Kim Jong Un visited the cemetery for Chinese People's Volunteer Army martyrs in South Pyongan province on the 73rd anniversary of the Korean War armistice, a symbolic gesture underscoring the China-North Korea relationship as state media also reported Pentagon figures of 642 US casualties from the Iran campaign.
flags: State-media source — treat framing with caution

picks.title: Беспилотники ВСУ атаковали коммерческий объект в Белгороде
picks.origTitle: Беспилотники ВСУ атаковали коммерческий объект в Белгороде
picks.summary: Russian state media reports Ukrainian drones struck a commercial facility in Belgorod, part of a steady drumbeat of state coverage today also featuring candlelight vigils in Crimea for children it says were killed by Ukrainian forces.
flags: State-media source — treat framing with caution

picks.title: Глава LVMH Бернар Арно скупает французские СМИ — чтобы давить на журналистов, продвигать правую повестку, унижать своих конкурентов и, конечно, богатеть
picks.origTitle: Глава LVMH Бернар Арно скупает французские СМИ — чтобы давить на журналистов, продвигать правую повестку, унижать своих конкурентов и, конечно, богатеть
picks.summary: Meduza summarizes a Le Monde investigation into LVMH chief Bernard Arnault's buyout of French media outlets, alleging he uses them to pressure journalists, push a conservative/right-wing agenda, undercut business rivals, and shield LVMH from unflattering coverage.
flags: Allegations sourced to a rival outlet's (Le Monde) investigation into a media-owning billionaire

picks.title: Polvo del Sahara llega antes, con mayor frecuencia y permanece más tiempo en Puerto Rico: ¿qué implica?
picks.origTitle: Polvo del Sahara llega antes, con mayor frecuencia y permanece más tiempo en Puerto Rico: ¿qué implica?
picks.summary: Saharan dust is arriving earlier in the season, more frequently, and lingering longer over Puerto Rico, a shift experts say is driving up respiratory and inflammatory illness even among otherwise healthy residents.

picks.title: AI firms want more data centers; Trump's EPA may give neighbors less say
picks.summary: A proposed EPA rule change would let states decide how much — if any — public input communities get before new AI data centers are approved nearby, as the industry pushes to speed up construction.
flags: Rule would reduce, not expand, affected residents' input

picks.title: Robot snakes searched for Venezuela earthquake survivors in collapsed buildings
picks.summary: US robotics researchers flew snake-like search robots to Venezuela to help hunt for survivors trapped in buildings collapsed by an earthquake, showcasing a niche disaster-response robotics application getting real-world use.
